title: Make the fall-through promise true everywhere it is written
action: mrs-24 (commit bc518499, decision fef79243) narrowed the code/read warn exemption into a MIGRATION WINDOW: an unconfigured role falls through and WARNS, except for the names code and read on a runtime whose models.<runtime> configures NEITHER of them — the pre-roles window, which shuts the moment the operator configures either key. mrs-24 fixed the FIX text in validate.rs to say exactly that, and capped with --sync-ack because the same un-narrowed promise is written in six other places it did not own: planning-reference.md around :167 and :215, swarming-reference.md around :378, cells-authoring-and-revision.md, docs/handbook/stages/planning.md, and .bee/config-sample.json. docs/config-reference.md is also in scope: mrs-25 rewrote it an hour before mrs-24 landed, so its fall-through-and-warns sentence is now incomplete rather than wrong. READ validate.rs's FIX text first and make every one of these agree with it — do not invent a seventh wording. Keep it proportionate: most of these want one clause, not a paragraph; only the config reference plausibly wants the full window explained. Do NOT hand-edit the mirror trees under .claude/, .codex-plugin/, .opencode/ and .claude-plugin/; run bee dev regen and let it write them, then bee dev release-manifest --check.
verify: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml devtools && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: Every shipped statement of the fall-through rule matches validate.rs's FIX text, including the migration window
No seventh wording is invented; the surfaces agree with the code, not merely with each other
The mirrors are written by regen and release-manifest --check passes
